# langsmith_experiment_view_override (Resource)

Manages the experiment view override configuration for a LangSmith dataset. Column overrides customize how experiment results are displayed in the UI (color gradients, numeric precision, column visibility). A dataset can have at most one override configuration. Import ID format: `<dataset_id>:<id>` or `<dataset_id>:<id>:<workspace_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "langsmith_dataset" "qa" {
  name      = "qa-dataset"
  data_type = "kv"
}

resource "langsmith_experiment_view_override" "qa" {
  dataset_id = langsmith_dataset.qa.id

  column_overrides = [
    {
      column         = "outputs.accuracy"
      precision      = 3
      color_gradient = jsonencode([[0, "#ff0000"], [0.5, "#ffff00"], [1, "#00ff00"]])
    },
    {
      column = "inputs.internal_notes"
      hide   = true
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `column_overrides` (Attributes List) Per-column display overrides. At least one entry is required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--column_overrides))
- `dataset_id` (String) UUID of the dataset the override configuration applies to.

### Optional

- `workspace_id` (String) If set, overrides the provider-level `workspace_id` for all API calls made by this resource.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `modified_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--column_overrides"></a>
### Nested Schema for `column_overrides`

Required:

- `column` (String) Column identifier; must start with `inputs`, `outputs`, `reference_outputs`, `feedback`, `metrics`, `attachments`, or `metadata` (e.g. `outputs.accuracy`).

Optional:

- `color_gradient` (String) JSON-encoded array of `[number, color]` stops for numeric data visualization, e.g. `jsonencode([[0, "#ff0000"], [1, "#00ff00"]])`. Max 20 stops.
- `color_map` (String) JSON-encoded object mapping categorical values to colors.
- `disable_colors` (Boolean) Disable color rendering for this column.
- `hide` (Boolean) Hide the column in the experiment view.
- `precision` (Number) Decimal places for numeric columns (1-6).
